description: This Java class 'WrappingMessageMapper' enforces message size limits and manages message mapping logic, including adding correlation IDs if missing, within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: WrappingMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class that wraps another MessageMapper to enforce message size limits and add correlation IDs.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a new WrappingMessageMapper that wraps the provided MessageMapper.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the delegate MessageMapper.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the content type blocklist from the delegate.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns default options from the delegate.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns incoming conditions from the delegate.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns outgoing conditions from the delegate.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided mapping configuration and settings, setting message size limits.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects, enforcing inbound message limits.

methods.name: map (Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable to a list of ExternalMessages, enforcing outbound message limits and adding response IDs.

methods.name: checkMaxMappedMessagesLimit
methods.description: Checks if the number of mapped messages exceeds the maximum allowed, throws exception if so.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the delegate MessageMapper.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the delegate.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the WrappingMessageMapper.
